rationale.method_and_sample_versions: Effect-bearing records must never exist without a method version and reproducible sample manifest.
rationale.lineage_status: M11D allocation must explicitly disclose whether it aligns with the current M11C view.
rationale.causal_claim: Every increment decomposition must explicitly keep causal_claim false.
rationale.amount_identification_counts: A strict bundle amount must always disclose pair and model-family counts.
rationale.pm_labels: PM rows and reports must explicitly carry confidence and data-scope language rather than renderer defaults.
